from PIL import Image,ImageOps
from io import BytesIO
def preview_png(data,bounds=(128,128)):
    with Image.open(BytesIO(data)) as opened:
        im=ImageOps.exif_transpose(opened).convert('RGBA')
    ratio=min(1,bounds[0]/im.width,bounds[1]/im.height)
    im=im.resize((max(1,round(im.width*ratio)),max(1,round(im.height*ratio))),Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)
    flat=Image.new('RGB',im.size,'white');flat.paste(im,(0,0),im.getchannel('A'))
    stream=BytesIO();flat.save(stream,'PNG');return stream.getvalue()

from PIL import Image, ImageOps
from io import BytesIO

def contact_sheet(images,columns=3,cell=(64,64),gap=4):
    if type(columns) is not int or columns<1 or type(gap) is not int or gap<0:
        raise ValueError('Неверная сетка')
    if len(cell)!=2 or any(type(v) is not int or v<1 for v in cell):
        raise ValueError('Неверная ячейка')
    if not images:return None
    import math
    rows=math.ceil(len(images)/columns)
    result=Image.new('RGB',(columns*cell[0]+(columns-1)*gap,rows*cell[1]+(rows-1)*gap),'white')
    for index,source in enumerate(images):
        image=source.convert('RGBA')
        image.thumbnail(cell)
        x=index%columns*(cell[0]+gap)+(cell[0]-image.width)//2
        y=index//columns*(cell[1]+gap)+(cell[1]-image.height)//2
        result.paste(image,(x,y),image.getchannel('A'))
    return result
